An Act to Amend the Universities
Act, no. 16 of 1978
BE it enacted by the Parliament of the Democratic Socialist
Republic of Sri Lanka as follows: -
1. This Act may be cited as the Universities (Amendment) Short title
Act, No. 2 of 2026.

“The Dean shall be elected” to the end of the
re-lettered paragraph (a), of the following: -
“The Dean shall be elected by the

Senior Lecturer (Grade I) is elected

paragraph (a), and is, at the time of
election, holding the post of the Head of

such Senior Professor, Professor,
Associate Professor or Senior Lecturer

the Head of that Department of Study
upon being elected as the Dean of the
Faculty.”;
(3) in subsection (2) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “unless removed from office,”, of
the words “unless removed from office by the
Council in accordance with the due procedure, as
may be specified by the Commission,”;
(4) in subsection (3) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “another Head of a Department
of that Faculty”, of the words “another Senior
Professor, Professor, Associate Professor or
Senior Lecturer (Grade I), of that Faculty”; and
(5) by the addition immediately after subsection (3)
of that section, of the following new subsection: -
“(4) No person shall be elected as the Dean
of a Faculty for more than two terms.”.

(1) by the repeal of subsection (1) of that section and the
substitution therefor, of the following subsection: -
“(1) (a) The Head of a Department of Study
shall be a Senior Professor appointed by the
Council upon the recommendation of the
Vice-Chancellor.
(b) In the absence of a Senior Professor a
Professor, an Associate Professor, a Senior
Lecturer (Grade I) or a Senior Lecturer
(Grade II) shall be appointed by the Council
in that order, as the Head of a Department
of Study, on the recommendation of the
Vice-Chancellor.
(c) Prior to make any such appointment
referred to in paragraph (a) or (b), the consent
of the selected individual with respect to such
appointment, shall be obtained.”;
(2) by the insertion immediately after subsection (1),
of the following new subsection: -
“(1A) (a) For the purpose of subsection (1),
any Senior Professor, Professor, Associate
Professor, or any Senior Lecturer (Grade I) or
any Senior Lecturer (Grade II), who has been
confirmed in the relevant post, shall be eligible
to be appointed as the Head of a Department
of Study.
(b) In the absence of a Senior Professor
Professor, Associate Professor, Senior Lecturer

(Grade I) or a Senior Lecturer (Grade II) for
the purpose of subsection (1), who is eligible
to be appointed as the Head of a Department of
Study, a Senior Professor, Professor, Associate
Professor or a Senior Lecturer (Grade I) in a
related discipline of another Department of
Study of the same Faculty, determined by the
Senate, shall be appointed in such capacity and
in such an event, the Vice-Chancellor shall
provide an explanation to the Council for such
appointment.”;
(3) in subsection (2) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “unless removed from office,”, of
the words “unless removed from office by the
Council in accordance with the due procedure, as
may be specified by the Commission,”;
(4) in subsection (3) of that section, by the substitution
for the words “the Vice-Chancellor shall appoint
another Professor, Associate Professor, Senior
Lecturer or Lecturer”, of the words “the Council
shall appoint, on the recommendation of the
Vice-Chancellor, another Senior Professor,
Professor, Associate Professor or a Senior Lecturer
(Grade I),”; and
(5) by the addition immediately after subsection (3)
of that section, of the following new subsection: -
“(4) No person shall be appointed as the
Head of the same Department of Study for
more than one term:

Universities (Amendment) 5
Act, No. 2 of 2026
Provided that, where all eligible persons in
a Department of Study have completed their
terms as the Head of that Department of Study
in accordance with the preceding provisions
and no other eligible persons are available for
such appointment, a person who has previously
held the post of the Head of that Department of
Study may, with the consent of such person,
be re-appointed to the post of the Head of that
Department of Study. Such re-appointment
shall be made in accordance with the procedure
set out in subsection (1A):
Provided further, no person shall hold the
post of the Head of a Department of Study for
more than two consecutive terms.”.
